product.name: Clementine UVVIS 750 nm Global Mosaic 118 m v2.1 (USGS Astrogeology)
product.label: https://planetarymaps.usgs.gov/mosaic/Lunar_Clementine_UVVIS_750nm_Global_Mosaic_118m_v2_pds3.lbl
product.chosen: owner, 2026-09-24, over LRO WAC morphology mosaic (baked shading)

poles.source: LOLA LDAM polar normal albedo, Lemelin et al. (2016), PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
poles.chosen: owner, 2026-09-25: replace Clementine poleward of ~70 deg (docs/stories/SS-6b.md)
poles.conventions: polar stereographic, R = 1737.4 km, 1000 m/px, planetocentric, east-positive, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421, 1064 nm normal albedo
poles.blend: smoothstep weight from 0 at |latitude| 65 to 1 at 75 deg; LOLA alone poleward, Clementine alone equatorward
poles.orientation: DSMAP_POLAR.CAT prose (90 E to the right at both poles; south lon 0 up, north lon 0 down); its south-pole inverse formula disagrees and was not used

gapFill.source: LOLA LDAM_10_FLOAT global normal albedo, Lemelin et al. (2016), PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
gapFill.conventions: simple cylindrical, R = 1737.4 km, 10 px/deg (3032 m/px at the equator), planetocentric, east-positive, MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421, 1064 nm normal albedo

localMatch.method: Clementine minus calibrated LOLA, spread into each gap by pull-push

conventions.latitude: planetocentric (identical to planetographic on a sphere)
conventions.longitude: east-positive; column 0 = -180 deg, last column ends at +180 deg
conventions.bodyFixedFrame: MOON_ME (LRO-era mean Earth/polar axis); see ephemeris.json
conventions.values: relative albedo 1-255 on Clementine's scale, linear; LOLA mapped onto it by the fits under poles
conventions.gaps: texture.mask, when present, is authoritative: white = never measured, and albedo values there are compression filler. Absent when every pixel was measured

formatChoice.rule: smallest albedo with albedo + mask <= 6291456 bytes and PSNR >= 42.0 dB over imaged pixels and over the Clementine region (|lat| < 65) alone

calibration.source: NASA Moon Fact Sheet, 'Visual geometric albedo 0.12' (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html)
calibration.model: Lommel-Seeliger, I/F = (w/4) mu0/(mu0+mu), w = albedoScale * texture value in [0, 1]
calibration.method: zero-phase disc mean of I/F equals the geometric albedo: albedoScale = 8p / mean(v), v weighted by projected area over the hemisphere facing longitude 0, latitude 0, gaps excluded
